affected.note: The notice says about 23,000 people; its breakdown totals 22,085, of whom 9,352 also had bank names and account numbers. The CSV file was sent unprotected to 53 members.

summary.en: biima, which runs the children's sports school biima sports, mistakenly attached an unprotected CSV file with personal data of 22,085 current, former and trial members to a notice email sent to 53 members on 2024-11-11. Bank account details of 9,352 people were included.
summary.ja: 子ども向けスポーツ教室「biima sports」を運営するbiimaは、2024年11月11日に会員53人へ送ったお知らせメールに、体験者や過去の在籍者を含む22,085人分の個人情報を含むCSVファイルを誤って添付した。うち9,352人分には金融機関名と口座番号が含まれていた。
